ruled_out.statement: Complete list of meromorphic solutions (project note Theorem 3): constants 0, 1 (every c); K*exp(-beta z/alpha) at c = alpha + beta/alpha; 1 + K*exp(-beta z/alpha) at c = beta/alpha; at c = c* = alpha/2 + 2 beta/alpha every local solution is meromorphic: fronts 1/(1 + K e^{alpha z/2}) (level C = 0) and the Bessel family (level C != 0). For every other c only the constants.

ruled_out.statement: (I) O_2 = 0: every solution is meromorphic, v = -(2/b)*y'/y with y'' - nu*y' + (b/2)*F(z)*y = 0, F = C*exp(mu*z) - c0/mu or c0*z + C (cards Q21-D1-RICCATI-EXP, Q21-AIRY-RICCATI). (II) O_2 != 0: no pole is possible; the meromorphic solutions are the constants and the entire solutions k*exp(kappa*z) + L(kappa)/c2 (card Q21-LIENARD-EXP) or -(c1/b)*z + k on their loci

basis.text: Theorem B (for the Burgers-Fisher normalisation c != 0, e^2 != 4cf this is pullback_nail Theorem 3, agent-refereed and in print: Ng-Wu 2019). The proof uses standard Nevanlinna tools (lemma on the logarithmic derivative, first main theorem), quoted and not read in this run. [LITCHECK: read: Ng-Wu 2019, Theorems 1.4-1.5 (pp. 5-6); Conte-Ng-Wu, Theorem 1 (p. 6)]

ruled_out.statement: Theorem B of project note. R = 0: every solution is meromorphic, (D + 2c/b)(v' - (b/2) v^2 - mu v - nu) = 0: Riccati over the clock exp(-2cz/b) (c != 0; ORD2-Q21-BND-BESSEL), over the time z read from an integral (c = e = 0 != f; ORD2-Q21-BND-AIRY), or with constant coefficients (c = e = f = 0; ORD2-Q21-BND-RICCONST). R != 0: the meromorphic solutions are entire: constants, an exponential family on one hypersurface (c != 0; ORD2-Q21-BND-EXP), a linear polynomial (c = 0, b f = d e; ORD2-Q21-BND-LIN); otherwise none (ORD2-Q21-BND-NOWAVE-C, -0).

normal_form.latex: w'' = -2 w w' - w^{2} + \frac{\alpha \left(- \alpha + 2 c\right)}{4 \beta} w - \frac{\alpha^{2} c \left(- \alpha + c\right)}{16 \beta^{2}}
steps: divide by the coefficient of w2
shift w -> w + (c/alpha) removes the term in w1
scale so that the coefficient of w0*w1 is 2 and that of w0**2 is 1
normal_form.convention: monic in wK; shift kills the coefficient of m*/w0; coefficient of m* = T (a0 = 1 in the two-term balance); coefficient of the next monomial m1 = 1; see mero.transform
